summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime zip from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary in a temp directory, and then invokes it against a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. `setup.mjs` itself uses obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and string-array indirection to hide ordinary stdlib calls (fs, https, zlib, execFileSync). `math_init.js` is a single-line Bun-format bundle with a shuffled string-array dispatcher (`WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`, `hc1jfK9`) and no readable strings; it never runs under Node, only under the freshly downloaded Bun binary. The package advertises itself as a react/legacy-css repo configuration helper, a purpose that has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque bundled payload. Installing the package causes the obfuscated payload to execute on the installer's machine under the downloaded Bun runtime via `execFileSync`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
